graph.title: Stephanie and Mailbox
notes: The booklet page is small and low-resolution, so several steps are my best reading of the pictures. Piece ids are b1-b25. This one page holds the whole mailbox (b1-b5) and the whole flower-stand model (b6-b25).
Mailbox: the red box b2 sits on the lime round brick b1. The door b3 slides into the box and is recorded as a hinge join. The two dark pink sloped bricks b4 and b5 form the roof.
Stand step 1: the white 2x4 brick b6 and the white 1x4 brick b7 are shown side by side. I could not tell how they connect, so b7 is joined to b6 only by an assumed edge.
Stand step 2: I assumed the black hinge base b8 and the two white 3x1 slopes b9 and b10 sit on b6.
Stand step 3: the light gray hinge top plate b11 is hinged to b8. The two white cones b12 and b13 sit on the slopes.
Stand step 4: the pearl gold supports b15 and b16 sit on the cones. The white 2x4 plate b14 is placed over the hinge plate b11.
Stand step 5: the red jumper plate b17 and the green flower stem b18 sit on b14. The three pink flowers b19-b21 sit on the stem.
Stand step 6: the black 2x2 plate b22 sits on b14. It carries two pink cheese slopes b23 and b24 and one reddish brown round plate b25. I could not make out the exact placement.

Some parts in the inventory are not visible on this page and are not placed: the Stephanie minifigure parts, the envelope tile, the two red 3x2 plates, the red 1x2 brick and the red jumper plate. Others are only partly used: the second white 2x4 plate, two cheese slopes, two pink round plates, one brown round plate, the white side-stud brick and the white 3004-type pieces.
All edges use null ports because I could not determine which studs are used. The rests_on relations are recorded as joined edges.
Page 2: the roof sub-assembly (steps 1-3) is built b26-b31 and set on the pearl gold posts b15 and b16 in step 7. Step 8 adds the two red 3x2 plates b32 and b33 as a heart-shaped top.

The pink canopy slopes are drawn larger than cheese slopes, so I used lego-3040b for b29 and b30. The mailbox roof on page 1 was also read as lego-3040b, but the parts list has only two. One of those readings is wrong, and the roof pieces may really be cheese slopes or 4286-style slopes.
Step 2 is unclear. I read it as the red 1x2 brick b27 and the red 1x2 jumper plate b28 on the white plate b26. The white side-stud brick b31 sits on the jumper stud.
The lower red plate b32 is attached to the side stud of b31, shown as a joined edge on port stud.side.1. The upper plate b33 is stacked on b32, offset, to make the heart.
The mailbox, Stephanie and the envelope are shown finished in step 8 and add no new pieces. Stephanie and the envelope are not recorded.

Parts-list fix: the booklet has only two lego-3040b, so I re-declared b29 and b30 (the canopy slopes) as lego-54200 cheese slopes. That gives 2 x 3040b (mailbox roof b4 and b5) and 4 x 54200 (b23, b24, b29, b30). The re-declared b29 and b30 keep their existing edges.

Parts-list fix: added the two pink round plates b35 and b36 and a second reddish brown round plate b37 (lego-6141), which I had missed in step 6. I put the pink plates on the cheese slopes b23 and b24 and b37 on the black plate b22. The exact placement is a guess from the small inset.
Parts-list fix: added the envelope tile b34 (lego-3069bpr0055). Stephanie holds it, and Stephanie is not a catalogue part, so it has no join edges. It is the only unconnected piece.

The two disconnected groups are real. The booklet builds separate models: the mailbox (b1-b5), the flower stand (b6-b33), Stephanie and the envelope. Nothing joins them. I kept them separate on purpose.
This is the complete graph. It replaces my earlier replies, because re-declaring an existing id did not change its type.

Parts-list fix: b29 and b30 (the canopy slopes) are now lego-54200 cheese slopes. That gives 2 x 3040b (the mailbox roof, b4 and b5) and 4 x 54200 (b23, b24, b29, b30), which matches the parts list. The pink round plates b35 and b36, the second brown round plate b37 and the envelope tile b34 are included.

The three groups are real and I kept them separate on purpose. The booklet builds three separate models: the mailbox (b1-b5), the flower stand (b6-b33 and b35-b37), and Stephanie holding the envelope tile b34. Nothing in the booklet joins them, and Stephanie is not a catalogue part, so b34 has no join edges.

Placements for steps 1-2 and 6 and the roof sub-assembly are best guesses from small, low-resolution pictures. The exact studs are unknown, so all stud-to-stud edges have null ports. The pink plates b35 and b36 sit on the cheese slopes b23 and b24, which is a guess.
